style.visual_target: Realistic live screenshot mockup, not just a pure UI design draft, nor just a character poster, with high natural integration of the host's real image and the platform interface.
style.rendering: Real photographic quality portrait + overlay UI of live streaming platform + commercial advertisement level clarity
style.color_tone: Tech Blue + Live Stream Red + Commercial Warm Light Fill.
style.composition: 9:16 vertical live stream screenshot composition, with the character occupying the visual center, UI sections clearly readable

must_keep: Elon Musk image recognizable but not cartoonish
The live stream UI has clear layers, with chat area, gift area, and product cards all necessary
Overall, it looks like a real live broadcast screenshot, rather than a simple collage.
avoid: UI Chinese text is blurry or contains spelling errors
An overly crowded interface leads to the anchor being obscured.
Low contrast between chat box and background leading to unclear text
